horizon_note: Scheduled and expected events. Dates can move; official sources are linked on each event.

events.title: US midterm elections
events.why: All 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats. Control of Congress shapes US trade, tariff and foreign policy.

events.title: COP31 UN climate summit, Antalya
events.why: Turkey hosts and Australia leads the negotiations. Climate finance and new national targets are the issues to watch for India.

events.title: Quarterly jobs survey (PLFS), July to September
events.why: Urban unemployment and labour participation: the data behind every jobs debate.
events.note: From MoSPI's release calendar. A release that falls on a holiday moves to the next working day.

events.title: Retail inflation (CPI) for October
events.why: Inflation is what the RBI targets, so this number shapes the next rate decision.
events.note: From MoSPI's release calendar. A release that falls on a holiday moves to the next working day.

events.title: Monthly unemployment rate for October
events.why: India's monthly unemployment rate from the Periodic Labour Force Survey.
events.note: From MoSPI's release calendar. A release that falls on a holiday moves to the next working day.

events.title: Census: online self-enumeration in UP, Punjab, Goa and Uttarakhand
events.why: India's first digital census starts early in the four states that vote in 2027.

events.title: APEC leaders' meeting, Shenzhen
events.why: Asia-Pacific trade and supply chains, hosted by China. India is not a member, but outcomes affect its trade partners.

events.title: Industrial output (IIP) for October
events.why: A monthly read on factories, mining and power: an early signal of how the economy is doing.
events.note: From MoSPI's release calendar. A release that falls on a holiday moves to the next working day.

events.title: GDP growth, July to September quarter
events.why: The headline measure of how fast India is growing; the number most often quoted in economy GDs.
events.note: From MoSPI's release calendar. A release that falls on a holiday moves to the next working day.

events.title: Parliament's Winter Session
events.why: Where pending bills are debated and passed; watch the legislative agenda when it is announced.
events.note: Usually runs late November to December. Dates not yet announced.

events.title: Census: door-to-door enumeration in UP, Punjab, Goa and Uttarakhand
events.why: The house-to-house count in the poll-bound states, with a reference date of 5 January 2027.

events.title: RBI monetary policy decision
events.why: The MPC meets 2 to 4 December and announces the repo rate on the 4th. Borrowing costs, the rupee and bank stocks all move on it.
events.note: Meeting runs 2 to 4 December; decision on the final day.

events.title: US Federal Reserve rate decision
events.why: Fed decisions move global capital flows, the dollar and the rupee, and shape how much room the RBI has.
events.note: Meeting 8 to 9 December; the decision lands around 12:30 am IST on 10 December.

events.title: Retail inflation (CPI) for November
events.why: Inflation is what the RBI targets, so this number shapes the next rate decision.
events.note: From MoSPI's release calendar. A release that falls on a holiday moves to the next working day.

events.title: G20 leaders' summit, Miami
events.why: The world's largest economies under a US presidency; trade, debt and energy are on the agenda.

events.title: Monthly unemployment rate for November
events.why: India's monthly unemployment rate from the Periodic Labour Force Survey.
events.note: From MoSPI's release calendar. A release that falls on a holiday moves to the next working day.

events.title: Industrial output (IIP) for November
events.why: A monthly read on factories, mining and power: an early signal of how the economy is doing.
events.note: From MoSPI's release calendar. A release that falls on a holiday moves to the next working day.

events.title: First advance estimate of FY27 GDP
events.why: The first full-year growth estimate, and a key input into the Union Budget's numbers.
events.note: From MoSPI's release calendar. A release that falls on a holiday moves to the next working day.

events.title: Retail inflation (CPI) for December
events.why: Inflation is what the RBI targets, so this number shapes the next rate decision.
events.note: From MoSPI's release calendar. A release that falls on a holiday moves to the next working day.

events.title: Monthly unemployment rate for December
events.why: India's monthly unemployment rate from the Periodic Labour Force Survey.
events.note: From MoSPI's release calendar. A release that falls on a holiday moves to the next working day.

events.title: World Economic Forum, Davos
events.why: Business and political leaders set the year's narrative on growth, AI and geopolitics.

events.title: US Federal Reserve rate decision
events.why: First Fed decision of 2027.
events.note: Meeting 26 to 27 January; tentative schedule published by the Fed.

events.title: Industrial output (IIP) for December
events.why: A monthly read on factories, mining and power: an early signal of how the economy is doing.
events.note: From MoSPI's release calendar. A release that falls on a holiday moves to the next working day.

events.title: Union Budget 2027-28
events.why: The government's tax and spending plan for the year: the single biggest economic policy event in India.
events.note: Presented on 1 February by convention since 2017; the date is confirmed closer to the session.

events.title: Census: population count begins across India
events.why: The first census since 2011. It will reshape welfare targeting, delimitation and every per-capita statistic.
events.note: Reference date 1 March 2027.

events.title: RBI monetary policy decision
events.why: The last policy of FY27, coming days after the Union Budget, so it shows how the RBI reads the government's fiscal plans.
events.note: Meeting runs 3 to 5 February; decision on the final day.

events.title: Quarterly jobs survey (PLFS), October to December
events.why: Urban unemployment and labour participation: the data behind every jobs debate.

events.title: Assembly elections: UP, Punjab, Uttarakhand, Goa and Manipur
events.why: Five states vote, including Uttar Pradesh, the largest. Results shape the national political mood ahead of 2029.
events.note: Expected February to March 2027. The Election Commission has not announced dates.

events.title: GDP growth, October to December quarter, and second advance estimate
events.why: Updates the full-year growth picture weeks after the Budget.

events.title: US Federal Reserve rate decision
events.why: Comes with fresh Fed economic projections, so markets read it for the year's rate path.
events.note: Meeting 16 to 17 March; tentative.

events.why: Electors from Parliament and the state assemblies choose India's head of state.
events.note: Due in July 2027; dates not yet announced.
